I don't have any record of previous conversations with you. Each conversation I have starts fresh - I don't retain memory of past interactions between sessions.

If you're seeing a conversation history in your interface, that would be stored on your end (by whatever platform you're using to chat with me), not on mine. I can only see what's visible in our current conversation window.

In this current session, you've asked me two questions:
1. First, you asked me to tell you about myself
2. Now, you've asked what else we've spoken about and how you worded your interactions

That's the extent of what I can see from our conversation together.
